paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 7.4 as of July 24, 2026, with a change of 12.46% from the prior close and -15.91% over a 20-session window. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Recent news includes a headline from Stocktwits where Fermi Cofounder Toby Neugebauer stated that the market is signaling support for cooperation between him and the company's board, as Fermi shares surged to over a 3-month high.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent SEC filings, including the appointment of four new officers and the disclosure of the resignation of director Miles Everson, as well as the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings in total.
